create_autoaugment_policy: create an AutoAugment instance that randomly applies CIFAR-10 image augmentation policies to PIL images
apply_policy_to_image: apply a two-operation augmentation policy with probability thresholds to a PIL image
run_shear_transform: run a shear_x or shear_y affine transform on a PIL image with a given magnitude level
run_translate_transform: run a translate_x or translate_y affine transform on a PIL image with a given magnitude level
run_image_enhance: run contrast, color, brightness, or sharpness enhancement on a PIL image using ImageEnhance
